claims.statement: The Commission states that large companies and financial institutions request sustainability information from SMEs and that VSME is intended to reduce the resulting administrative burden and repeated requests.
SMEs bear the internal reporting burden and may benefit through supply-chain participation or finance access, but evidence that Polish SMEs will pay the proposed price is absent.

A plausible control path is an annual direct service and data-processing contract that makes the venture the reusable evidence source while leaving the SME in control of disclosures; no contract is secured.

The Commission explicitly encourages digital tools and is exploring e-invoicing extraction for VSME reporting, validating automation as a direction but also signaling likely public or incumbent alternatives.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Owner, CFO, finance lead, tender manager, or quality/compliance lead
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: The offer must be cheaper and faster than consulting while retaining auditable evidence and portability across requesters
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The SME owns its buyer and lender relationships; the proposed reporting-service relationship does not yet exist
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accounting office or procurement adviser already trusted with company records

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Accounting-partner enablement and targeted outreach to supplier clusters
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Deposit at kickoff and balance on delivery; annual renewals can be prepaid
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Moderate initially and potentially high after repeatable templates, but evidence chasing can dominate delivery cost
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Evidence chasing, classification, exception review, and customer education
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: GDPR, security, professional liability, methodology updates, and quality review
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Target 2,500-8,000 PLN for first-year passport, 1,500-4,000 PLN refresh, and 300-1,000 PLN per bespoke mapping
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Document extraction, secure storage, e-signing, reviewer time, and channel commission

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Accounting firms, ESG consultancies, banks, and procurement platforms can offer templates or bundle reporting
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Annual passport completion or a mapped questionnaire response is paid; measurable loss is staff and adviser time repeatedly collecting the same sustainability evidence
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: First material buyer questionnaire, tender requirement, lender request, or fear of losing preferred-supplier status
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual evidence refresh or a material change in facilities, workforce, energy, or financing

contrary_evidence: VSME is voluntary, so many SMEs can decline until a powerful counterparty asks.
The Commission and EFRAG already provide a digital template and support materials, limiting willingness to pay for basic form filling.
Omnibus simplification may reduce or standardize downstream requests enough that only a small service layer remains.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed 12-month nonexclusive service agreement with data-processing terms; none secured
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Offer a one-time evidence inventory and exportable VSME workbook without retaining the relationship
critical_control_point.current_owner: The SME and the organizations requesting its information
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The SME owns its buyer and lender relationships; the proposed reporting-service relationship does not yet exist
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Public VSME materials and lawful outreach to SMEs and accounting offices are available; no customer data or channel commitment is secured
critical_control_point.renewal: Proposed annual refresh before buyer or lender reporting cycles
critical_control_point.subject: Annual SME sustainability evidence and response relationship

economics.acquisition_route: Accounting offices, lender advisers, procurement consultants, and targeted supplier clusters
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Conditional path: 1,000 annual clients at a 4,000 PLN blended fee equals 4m PLN revenue before channel and delivery costs; software-assisted margins and repeatability could create a value above 5m PLN, but neither is proven
economics.founder_time: A templated five-client pilot can fit 3-5 hours daily; evidence chasing must be bounded before adding volume
economics.gross_margin_basis: Fixed fee less reviewer labor, document tooling, secure storage, and partner commission
economics.payback: Target within one material questionnaire or tender cycle versus internal and adviser time; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Discovery hypothesis: 2,500-8,000 PLN first-year pack, 1,500-4,000 PLN annual refresh, plus bounded response fees
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual refresh plus episodic requester mappings; retention depends on recurring external requests

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned mapping library from recurring source documents to VSME fields and buyer question variants reduces production time
fingerprint.customer: Polish SMEs supplying large companies or seeking bank and sustainable-finance relationships
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: White-label or referral distribution through accounting offices, SME lenders, procurement advisers, and industry clusters
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Productized VSME data collection, evidence vault, signed annual report, and questionnaire mapping
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The SME pays for an annual evidence passport and optionally for each mapped buyer or lender response
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A buyer, tender, lender, or corporate customer sends a sustainability questionnaire or asks for standardized evidence

founder_fit: Data normalization and evidence-quality checks fit business-analysis and data-science skills
The work can begin as a tightly scoped asynchronous service alongside employment
Accounting-channel distribution reduces dependence on constant networking or personal-brand content
Each engagement produces measurable turnaround, reuse, and labor-savings data
risks: Clients may treat the service as legal assurance beyond its scope
Incorrect or unsupported disclosures could harm tenders or financing
Free templates and accountant bundles can commoditize the offer
Manual evidence collection can cap scale

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: fixed scope annual vsme passport and requester mapping service
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: recurring source of truth relationship for an sme s sustainability evidence
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: smes must gather underlying evidence and counterparties must accept standardized responses

structure.commercial_archetype: Annual productized reporting service with optional response packs
structure.control_point: The SME's reusable source-of-truth relationship for sustainability evidence
structure.critical_dependency: SME willingness to gather evidence and downstream requesters' acceptance of VSME-based responses

thesis: Observed labor-allocation change: the European Commission says SMEs are receiving sustainability-information requests from large companies and financial institutions, and it recommended VSME to replace a substantial portion of those questionnaires. Sell small Polish suppliers a reusable, evidence-backed annual passport plus bounded response service, distributed through accounting firms that already assemble financial records.
title: VSME Supplier Evidence Passport
uncertainties: Frequency and commercial consequence of VSME-aligned requests among Polish supplier SMEs
Acceptance of a reusable passport across different buyers and banks
Document availability and evidence quality at very small firms
Channel appetite among accounting offices and the support load per client
